outline:
專題報告 專題演講 研究小組討論:

This course is to provide you an environment for practicing your presentation skills for your RESERCH
•	We have done presentation for general information in last semester
•	Follow up of our previous seminar:
	Show you are a profession in this research field
	More details, discussion, and deep explanation

KEY: PPPPP
(Prior Planning Prevents Poor Performance)

For research presentation, the slides’ structure would include (but not limited to)
1.	Outline
2.	Motivation
3.	Main body (the discussed topic/issues)
--algorithms/math models/theoretical analysis…etc
4.	Experimental/simulation results
5.	Conclusion
6.	Future work and reference
